data.name: Dreadful Charm Stain
data.description: You no longer cast a shadow. Noticing this in normal or bright light requires a successful DC 15 Perception check. Also, if you're in an area that smells strongly of garlic, you must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude save or be sickened for 1d4 minutes. Immunities don't prevent this sickened condition.
